body: Where should a small business start with AI? The 5-step audit I'd run before buying any tool.
"We should use AI" is not a plan. Most businesses start with a tool. Start with the work instead.

1. Map a normal week: every task that happens more than once, who does it, how long it takes.
2. Score each task: hours per week × how boring it is × how low-risk it is.
3. Automate one thing properly. One working automation beats ten half-built ones.
4. Measure the hours saved for a month.
5. Repeat with the next task.
Save this for your next planning day.
